question.text:
In an atom, total number of electrons having quantum numbers \(\mathrm{n}=4,\left|\mathrm{~m}_l\right|=1\) and \(\mathrm{m}_{\mathrm{s}}=-\frac{1}{2}\) is
______

solution.text:
$\mathrm{n}=4$ $\ell \quad \mathrm{m}_{\ell}$ $\begin{array}{ll} 0 & 0 \\ 1 & -1,0,+1 \\ 2 & -2,-1,0,+1,+2,+3 \end{array}$
So number of orbital associated with $\mathrm{n}=4,\left|\mathrm{~m}_{\ell}\right|=1 \text { are } 6$
Now each orbital contain one $e^{-}$with $m_s=-\frac{1}{2}$
